How updates work

Every change is logged.

Guidance goes out of date when a process changes and nobody says so. From V.02, every course shows who owns it, its version, and the date it was last updated, and every change is listed on the course and on this page.

  • Each course has a Course record at the bottom: owner, version, review status, and what changed.
  • Pay-impacting courses carry a Before you submit block: what to attach, what to check, the cutoff, and who does what.
  • Anything not yet confirmed is marked To confirm or listed as an open item, so nobody mistakes a draft for a rule.

To confirmWho tells HCMs when a pay-impacting course changes, how the notice is sent, and how often each course is reviewed.

Owners

Which team owns each course.

The owning team keeps its courses current and confirms the open items. Owners are teams, not individuals.

Nov 18, 2026 · V.02 draft

What the SME review changed.

Vanderbilt subject matter experts reviewed the courses in Start Here, Hiring, Payroll, Assignments, Costing, and Records. What they stated is now in the courses; what they asked is listed as an open item. Each course's record says what changed.

Reorganized

  • Job Architecture is now two courses: Part 1, how talent is organized, and Part 2, how it is set up in Oracle.
  • When to create a new position or update one is now part of Create a position.
  • Review and approve time cards, Enter PTO, and the two UKG courses for managers and employees are now one course: UKG time cards and time off.
  • Change existing costing is now part of Enter costing for a person.
  • Change salary moved to Assignment Changes (Payroll still owns it), and Add Assignment moved to Students & Faculty.
  • Start Here went from nine courses to six, with nothing dropped. A new course, What is an HCM?, explains the role and includes Who owns what. Data integrity is now part of Oracle HCM structure, Workflow and worklists part of Working in Oracle HCM, and Employee or independent contractor? part of Worker types, classification, and required checks. Each merged course shows both videos, as Part 1 and Part 2.
  • Awareness and best-practice courses folded in. Steps and processes stay as their own courses. Position management best practices is now part of Create a position; Executive or external search part of Create a requisition. Payroll essentials combines The HCM's role in payroll, Pay rules, Compensation impacts on payroll, and Common pay errors. UKG time cards now includes the Weekly time card check. Transfers and promotions covers both, with or without a requisition. Ending an assignment and terminating employment now includes multiple assignments. Costing essentials combines Costing fundamentals, Costing impacts, and When costing must be updated. Add Assignment now starts with choosing it over a new work relationship. Reporting basics combines the BI introduction and Reporting 101.
  • HCM means the role. Where a course means the system, it now says Oracle HCM. Finance partner now reads FUM (financial unit manager), Vanderbilt's term.

Old links to merged courses take you to the course that absorbed them.

Nov 13, 2026 · V.02 draft

Owners are teams.

Each course is owned by a team. The owner shows at the top of the course, on its job aid, and in its Course record.

  • Payroll owns all payroll and financial topics: 10 courses.
  • HRIS owns everything else, from recruiting and hiring through assignment changes, offboarding, leave, records and reporting, and the foundations: 39 courses.

The draft first showed the owners as Payroll and Finance and as Recruiting and Hiring, and 24 courses had no owner. Every course now has one.

From Vanderbilt's published pages

These facts were read from the HR/Payroll Calendar for 2026 and 2027 and from the Vanderbilt Student Privacy Statement. They replace guesses and close open items.

  • The Shared Administrative Calendar now follows the published calendar: where it is, each cutoff, and when time cards are due.
  • Monthly cutoff: the 18th in most months and earlier in December. Courses that said the 15th to the 18th are corrected.
  • Time cards: due at noon on the Monday after the pay period ends. Holiday weeks move it.
  • Off-cycle runs: about two a month, with a cutoff of noon two days before.
  • FERPA: Vanderbilt's directory information list, and the University Registrar as the contact.

To confirmThe 2027 calendar adds a Semi Monthly payroll that no course covers yet, and the Retro Change Cutoff used by the costing courses is not on the published calendar.
